sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Firebase Sessions from collecting usage data.
Removes the feedback and rating popup that appears after watching videos.
Unlocks the pure black theme and custom subtitle fonts, and removes the premium prompts.
